title: Admin dashboard, install as an app & What's new
notes: Install HaloCard on your phone like an app — tap “Install app” in Account (works offline too).
You'll now see a short note like this whenever HaloCard is updated, and a “Refresh” bar when a new version is ready.
Admins: new Overview dashboard — revenue, sign-ups, plans, expiring plans, payments and top cards.
Admins: search and filter users.

title: A cleaner, more professional look
notes: New header and tab bar (My cards · Leads · Team).
Tidier card list with a ⋯ menu, and leads shown as clear panels with status tags.
The card editor now fits phones properly, and pop-ups slide up from the bottom on mobile.

title: Teams, events, referrals & monthly reports
notes: Business plan: Team page — one company brand for every staff card, all staff leads in one inbox.
Event mode: show “Meet me at…” on your card and tag leads by event.
🎁 Invite friends and earn free days of Pro.
Monthly scan report by email (switch off in Account).
Add to Google Wallet (once set up by the admin).

title: Business profile & NFC cards
notes: Pro cards: Verified badge, WhatsApp chat, booking, directions, reviews, opening hours, price list, intro video and 3 themes.
Leads: status, private notes, unread count and email alerts.
Order physical NFC cards (PVC or metal) and pay with MoMo.
Save your QR to your phone's photos to share offline.

title: Fixes
notes: PNG and PDF export fixed.
QR codes always open your card (no more “Copy”).
Save to Contacts opens your phone's contact screen; the back QR adds the contact in one scan.
Paystack payments confirm instantly when you return from paying.
